The campus budget risk calculator successfully passed all tests with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the weighted assessment logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 0.324s. While the logic is reusable, future iterations should re-check edge cases in the weighted-risk formula to ensure stability beyond the single successful trial.
